title: Optimal Subpattern Assignment Metric
text: Calculate Optimal Subpattern Assignment Metric, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Distance type} sets Distance type; {Metric}, {Cutoff distance} sets the threshold for cutoff distance between track, {Order}, {Custom distance function}, {Motion model} sets the desired platform motion, {Labeling error} sets the penalty for incorrect assignment, {Window length} sets the sliding window length for OSPA, {Window sum order (q)} sets the order of weighted sum for track and truth, {Window weights} sets the options for window weights, {Window weight exponent (r)} sets the exponent for automatic weight calculation, {Custom window weights} sets the custom weights in time window N -element of vector of nonnegative, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Assignments} enables assignment input, {Localization error} enables localization error component output, {Cardinality error} enables cardinality error component output, {Track bus}, {Truth bus}, {Track extractor function} and {Truth extractor function}. Values come from the instance.
